translations.web: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
translations.bsb: You who forbid adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
translations.kjv: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
translations.asv: thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou rob temples?
